# analysis.feet.FootList { #prosodic.analysis.feet.FootList }

`analysis.feet.FootList()`

| --- | --- |
| [footed_scansion](#prosodic.analysis.feet.FootList.footed_scansion) | The feet as a pipe-delimited w/s string, e.g. `'wws\|wws\|wws\|w'`. |
